content:
support_eli: Heads-up, customer (acme-ux) reports a big spike in latency and token usage today. They say many requests are hitting eu-west and us-east alternately and incurring cross-region tails. Likely related to their SDK retries.

alex_chen: Can you paste the SDK version and config from their app? hedged requests or cross-region fallback could cause that.

support_eli: They sent this snippet: `redwoodClient = new RedwoodClient({ region: 'eu-west-1', hedgedRequests: true, retry: { maxRetries: 5, backoffMs: 100 }})`. App host is in eu-west but traces show some requests routed to us-east-1.

maria_garcia: Oof. HedgedRequests + global fallback + aggressive retries = region hopping. Do we have any recent routing changes? @eng-runtime-oncall any rollouts that would change fallback priority?

eng-runtime-oncall: No routing policy change this morning. However last week we changed the hedged request attach behavior for low-SLO customers: hedged attempts will prefer different region when the primary route is unhealthy to get fast success. Might explain alternating.

support_eli: Customer sees 504s then a quick retry to us-east which succeeds but at high latency; billing doubled for the window. They want mitigation ASAP.

alex_chen: Short-term mitigation: ask them to disable hedgedRequests or set `preferLocalRegion: true` in client config. Also set maxRetries to 1.

samir_kapoor: We should also check for a bug where backoffMs is very low causing immediate cross-region hammering. If the SDK schedules hedged attempts too early it'll always trigger a remote region try.

maria_garcia: Can we provide a repro script they can run? Preferably a small loop that sets region and toggles hedges so they can see it locally.

support_eli: They provided a trace id: trace/0a1b2c3d4e. Logs show: `route selected: eu-west-1`, `attempt 2: fallback route us-east-1`, `duration: 920ms` then success.

eng-runtime-oncall: Debug note: routing policy uses a score that factors current call latency percentiles. If primary latency > SLOThreshold, fallback engages. But hedged logic currently ignores per-request pinning header. That is a bug — hedged attempts should honor explicit client pin to region. I'll open ENG-TICKET-4987.

ops-bot: @eng-runtime-oncall assigned ENG-TICKET-4987 to you. Priority: HIGH.

alex_chen: For the customer, immediate steps: 1) ask them to set `hedgedRequests:false` and `preferLocalRegion:true` 2) upgrade SDK to >= 2.14.1 which contains our temporary hedged backoff fix 3) collect a short repro (curl or node script) and send trace id.

maria_garcia: Draft reply for support_eli: "Sorry about the disruption — temporary workaround: disable hedged requests or pin region; we're escalating a bug on hedged attempts ignoring explicit region pinning. We'll follow up with a patch and mitigation." Add ETA?

support_eli: I'll send that and ask them to test disabling hedges now, will update here.

samir_kapoor: Long-term: runtime should ensure hedged attempts carry request headers like `X-Client-Region` and honor pinning. Also consider add a server-side circuit breaker per-client to avoid cross-region cost storms.

eng-runtime-oncall: Yep. I'll push a hotfix to ensure hedged attempts carry pin headers and throttle cross-region hedges for customers flagged for cost-sensitivity. Expect PR and canary tonight.

support_eli: Customer confirmed disable hedgedRequests reduced latency/cost within 10 minutes. They're still waiting on patch. Closing loop once ENG-TICKET-4987 has a deploy. :thumbsup:

devex-bot: Note: SDK 2.14.1 released with hedged backoff tweak. https://packages.redwood.ai/sdk/releases/2.14.1

alex_chen: Good catch everyone. Add remediation notes to the case: recommended config, repro steps, and timeline for runtime fix.

support_eli: Will do. Thread closed pending ENG-TICKET-4987 deploy.
